==Description==
The '''Supply Drop''' is one of the three uncommon [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''Supply Drop''' has a 6.94% (6.76% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 11.54% (8.82% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only up to three '''Supply Drops''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 75 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 60 seconds.

==Usage==
When using the '''Supply Drop''', your avatar's right hand will hold a radio, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where a '''Supply Drop''' will land. Upon landing, you will be able to collect it, giving you {{Money|1,000}}. Only the player who used the '''Supply Drop''' consumable can claim it.

==Appearance==
The '''Supply Drop''' consists of multiple crates, ammo boxes, an oil barrel and a gas can strapped to a wooden pallet. It will be dropped from a grey plane and will fall down with a parachute, which is removed upon landing.

==Strategy==
*The '''Supply Drop''' is very useful early on in the game, as the {{Money|1,000}} bonus is large compared to the amount normally obtained in the early waves.
**This can easily accelerate [[Farm]] upgrades or be used to place/upgrade more towers than usual to deal with enemies.
**Later on, however, the cash bonus is less useful as the cash obtained in the mid-game and late-game waves are larger, so the '''Supply Drop''' cash bonus will have less impact.

==Trivia==
*The '''Supply Drop''' will crush any player standing under it when it lands, killing them.
